payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to reduce data sparsity effects in neural machine translation systems for low-resourced language pairs.

claims.text: Advanced methods were combined to reduce the adverse impacts of data sparsity in NMT systems.
Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) was proposed as a method for effective word segmentation to alleviate the rare-word problem.
Data augmentation methods were employed to increase the amount of training data by exploiting monolingual data.
